0022600186.text: The Clippers (1-6, 13th in the West) host the Miami Heat (2-5, 10th in the East) in the Clippers' eighth game of the season, with the Clippers on a six-game losing streak and 0-4 on the road. Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are out for the Clippers, and Isaiah Jackson is day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision, while Giannis Antetokounmpo is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision for Miami. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers lost both games against Miami in 2025-26, most recently 140-123 in Miami on December 1, 2025.
